description: For the Übersetzungs-Agent: read a translation job — target language, glossary and the paragraphs to translate as [{id, text}], paged (offset, limit ≤ 120). Paragraphs already delivered are marked done. Translate each text faithfully and completely into the target language (keep numbers, units, deal/sample ids like 'P-3', names and addresses unchanged; apply the glossary exactly), then deliver with set_uebersetzung using the SAME ids. Read-only apart from marking the job 'in_arbeit'.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for paging)

name: get_uebersetzungsauftrag
